inspecting-empty-clam.text: The clam is empty. For some reason, you consider placing something inside.

inspecting-the-clam-after-putting-an-ite.text: The clam is shut and won't budge. You don't think you'll be seeing your item again.

placing-an-item-into-a-clam.text: Item: [item name] Do you really want to put it in the clam? You don't think you'll be able to get it back.
You place your item in the clam and it quickly snaps shut.

taking-a-pearl-from-a-clam.text: The clam seems to be offering you a pearl. You take it.

attempting-to-put-a-pearl-into-a-clam.text: The clam spits the pearl back at you, refusing to take it.
